results.title: Taiwan cherishes peace but will not give up freedom, president says
results.description: Taiwan cherishes peace but will not give up its freedom and there must be respect for the right of Taiwans people to exist President Lai Ching-te said on Saturday in a national day speech adding that boosting defences is not a provocation Democratically governed Taiwan has faced increased military and political pressure from China which views the island as its own territory over the strong objections of the government in Taipei
